query: What benefits can I get from the government if I am starting a small business?
ground_truth_answer: Entrepreneurs starting a small business in India can avail collateral-free loans under Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) up to 10-20 Lakhs across Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories, and capital subsidies up to 25%-35% for new manufacturing or service units under Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP).
expected_department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

query: How much financial support is provided annually under PM Kisan Samman Nidhi to farmers?
ground_truth_answer: Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive an income support of Rs. 6,000 per year, disbursed in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each directly into their bank accounts via DBT.

query: What subsidy is available for installing rooftop solar under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana?
ground_truth_answer: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana provides financial assistance and central subsidies for installing residential rooftop solar systems, offering up to 300 units of free electricity per month for households.
expected_department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

query: What are the loan limits and interest subsidies for street vendors under PM SVANidhi?
ground_truth_answer: PM SVANidhi provides working capital collateral-free credit to street vendors starting with a first tranche of up to Rs. 10,000, followed by Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 50,000 upon timely repayment, along with a 7% interest subsidy.

query: What is the monthly pension amount and age criteria under Atal Pension Yojana?
ground_truth_answer: Atal Pension Yojana offers a guaranteed monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month starting after attaining 60 years of age, open to Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years.
